registryBasis: Cameroon’s MINDCAF administers land, cadastre and land-affairs services. Its public organization/procedure materials define regional and departmental cadastral responsibilities; the Cameroon government eRegulations procedure directory specifically lists the Délégation départementale des domaines, du cadastre et des affaires foncières at Centre administratif, Garoua and the Bénoué departmental cadastre bureau. The public listing confirms a local registry/cadastre custodian, but no public parcel geometry service or schema was identified.
